exposure: Transvaginal natural orifice transluminal endoscopic surgery (vNOTES) hysterectomy +/- salpingo-oophorectomy
cohort: 46 women who underwent vNOTES hysterectomy +/- salpingo-oophorectomy for benign indications at three tertiary referral medical centers in Italy between July 2019 and April 2021.
finding: vNOTES hysterectomy is a feasible and safe alternative to conventional surgery in selected women.
